title: From the Planning Commission to NITI Aayog
sources: Cabinet Resolution on NITI Aayog, 1 January 2015

quiz.q: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in:

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: For 65 years, India planned its economy in five-year plans.
Then the Planning Commission was replaced.

beats.say: For 65 years, India planned its economy in five-year plans. Then the Planning Commission was replaced.

lines.say: The Planning Commission was set up by a resolution in March 1950.
The First Plan began in 1951. NITI Aayog replaced the commission on the first of January, 2015.

beats.say: The Planning Commission was set up by a resolution in March 1950. The First Plan began in 1951. NITI Aayog replaced the commission on the first of January, 2015.

lines.say: The Nehru years were state-led, with heavy industry first.
After 1991, planning became indicative, and market-friendly.

beats.say: The Nehru years were state-led, with heavy industry first. After 1991, planning became indicative, and market-friendly.

lines.say: Unlike the old commission, NITI Aayog doesn't allocate funds.
It's meant to be a think tank, and a forum for the states.

data.text: A think tank, with no power to allocate funds.

beats.say: Unlike the old commission, NITI Aayog doesn't allocate funds. It's meant to be a think tank, and a forum for the states.
